general.summary: Huawei Technologies Co. is preparing to release details of a new high-bandwidth memory chip that could potentially surpass current offerings from Samsung Electronics Co. and SK Hynix Inc., moving to launch Chinese production of a key AI component currently blocked by US sanctions.

general.title: China-Backed Pakistan Exchange Prepares to Launch Stock Options
general.summary: The Pakistani bourse is looking to introduce equity options next year, giving investors another tool to bet on a market that’s tripled over the past three years.

general.title: Trump Aims to Keep Leverage Over Xi With 40% China Tariff Threat
general.summary: China has signaled it’s unlikely to retaliate against new US tariffs that remain within the bounds of a previously agreed trade deal, but the threat of higher rates shows Washington wants to maintain some leverage over Beijing.

general.title: Dry Bulk Shipping Rates Climb as Capesize Vessel Supply Tightens
general.summary: A key measure of bulk shipping rates jumped this week as exporters competed for a shrinking pool of vessels during a seasonally tighter period.

general.title: Viettel, Singtel Building Subsea Cable for Data-Hungry Vietnam
general.summary: A consortium led by Viettel Group and Singapore Telecommunications is beginning construction on a submarine cable system in Ho Chi Minh City as Vietnam’s demand for internet bandwidth rapidly grows.

general.summary: A former top negotiator for Beijing says China and the US must manage the risks stemming from competition over AI. general.title: SoftBank Credit Risk Tops 500 Basis Points as AI Worries Mount
general.summary: SoftBank Group Corp.’s credit risk surged above 500 basis points for the first time in about four years, raising the prospect of even higher funding costs as the company presses ahead with massive investments in artificial intelligence.

general.summary: US chip curbs are putting the brakes on billions of dollars in AI data center financing across Asia, with lenders reassessing deals tied to Chinese tech firms including ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent.
